items.message: Final loop iteration returns `Validation(report=None, ...)` despite a valid report being in scope.
`validated` is called with `rounds=0` nowhere, but `with_directive` is called even when `rounds==0` would skip the repair; the guard is subtle.
`_Session.invoker` is set to `_Refusing()` but `validated` calls `run_phase`, which uses `session.invoker` indirectly through `AiInvoker`; the double may not wire correctly.
Two `materialize` calls per validation cycle regardless of whether the fixer ran.
Validator finding messages are masked by `Redact`, but the effectiveness depends on `Redact.text` covering linter output that may quote arbitrary file contents.
Finding lines rendered into the repair directive include raw `path`, `line`, and `message` from the validator — these reach the model turn without a sanitisation boundary.
_Validator.invoke uses `self.seen[0].fix` to detect 'a fix pass happened', but `self.seen[0]` is the very call being processed on the first invocation.
test_gate_validate_2_an_unclean_change_is_opened_as_a_draft asserts `unclean.ready == []` with the message 'a change with findings asked for review', which is the opposite of what the test intends.
test_gate_validate_2_every_strategy_that_reports_a_change_validates_it_first scans for bare-name `validated` calls only, missing qualified or aliased imports.
validated() falls through to `return Validation(report=None, ...)` after the loop exits normally, which can only happen if `rounds` is 0 and the initial report is not clean.
